tests.name: push-dispatch health reports the push_outcome counts (column migrated, outcome loader live)

tests.reason: FCM errors not counting as sends, the Appilix fallback firing, and every push_outcome value need a push to be attempted; staging shares the production database and real members' devices, so no suite may trigger a send. The Jest suites prove the behaviour with mocked FCM/Appilix; the read-only check after deploy is the outcome counts on the health endpoint and in user_notifications.
